$comment: Every npm package the TypeScript capability (Oxlint, oxfmt, tsrs, React Doctor) loads or
executes, at the exact versions this repo installs and tests: the binaries, the @sarj plugin
and the ESLint plugins oxlint.strict.mts loads under `jsPlugins`.
tsrs does all type checking and supplies `tsrs-lint` for type-aware rules, so there is no
TypeScript compiler pair. `typescript` stays only because @eslint-react/eslint-plugin imports
the TypeScript JavaScript API when it loads.
`eslint` is not run. It is pinned because the JS plugins peer on it and npm cannot resolve
their ranges on its own; see `ceilings` and `npmOverrides`.
`platformPackages` lists the platform binaries each peer ships as optionalDependencies at its own
version. Installs exempt the peers and these exact versions from the repository's release-age and
trust policies for that install only.

ceilings.eslint: Not run. eslint-plugin-unicorn 79 peers `eslint >= 10.4` and eslint-plugin-react 7.37.5 peers `eslint <= ^9.7`, so npm refuses the tree unless eslint is a direct dependency that the eslint-plugin-react override can point at.
ceilings.eslint-plugin-react: 7.37.5 is the newest release and peers `eslint <= ^9.7`; the npm override permits ESLint 10. Oxlint loads it as react-js for the two rules without a native port.
ceilings.typescript: @eslint-react/eslint-plugin imports the TypeScript JavaScript API at load time. TypeScript 7 has no JavaScript API, so the official TypeScript 6 compatibility package supplies it.
